representative_scale.scale_policy: One fixed ensemble; no scale search, doubling loops or toy extrapolation.

inputs.candidate_command_reason: Brief proposes concurrent MPS execution but provides no executable fixed-work concurrent driver or complete launch command. No command invented.

timing_scope.primary: Supplied total_wall_s starts immediately before sequential replica loop and stops after final context/integrator deletion. Includes context creation/kernel compilation, setting positions and velocities, integration, synchronized energy reads, summary construction and teardown.
timing_scope.excluded: Python imports, PDB reading, force-field/system/platform setup, JSON serialization, printing and process startup.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context, positions and velocities initialization; includes integration and energy reads; excludes context initialization and teardown.
timing_scope.candidate_requirement: Compare same eight replicas and equivalent ensemble timing scope, include all contexts and worker launch/join overhead inside ensemble work timing, use one GPU; do not compare sum of worker times.
timing_scope.external_timing_reason: Not emitted by supplied driver; must be distinguished from its internal ensemble total.

scoring_interface.integrity: Eight replica ids 0..7, seeds 1000..1007, 25,000 steps each, simulated_ns 0.8, finite per-replica energy summaries, same pinned configuration. These are structural checks, not published anchors.
scoring_interface.scientific_outcome: Compare corresponding mean and final energies; full series requires additional output. Exact equality proposed in brief; no published numeric accuracy tolerance or run-to-run variation supplied.
scoring_interface.acceptance_reason: No independently published fixed-work accuracy or speedup acceptance criterion. Brief speedup ranges are predictions, separate from published throughput reference.

runtime_evidence.estimate: About one minute for sequential ensemble on H100; few minutes on slower GPUs.
runtime_evidence.reason: Brief estimate unverified on CUDA; context compilation time unmeasured. Workload not executed during intake.
runtime_evidence.budget_feasibility: Fixed ensemble estimate substantially below default method_run budget, but no measured guarantee; stop at stage budget rather than searching scale.

gate_scripts_reason: No intake gate-script paths or commands named in prompt or brief; JSON and cross-file invariants validated locally.
